---
title: "Document capture"
description: "Add identity document capture to your application."
---

Let customers scan an ID or passport without leaving your application. Bouncr guides the capture, uploads the document, and makes verification results available to your backend.

The Web SDK provides camera controls and capture events. You build the screens with your own components, styles, and copy.

<Card title="Build your first capture screen" icon="react" href="/external/web">
  Follow the React quickstart to select a document, capture it, and retrieve your first result.
</Card>

## A capture from start to finish

Your customer chooses the issuing country and document, then opens the camera. Bouncr captures the required images automatically and processes the scan. Your backend retrieves the result and decides the next step in your application.

Each scan has an ID. Save it alongside the customer’s application or onboarding record so you can retrieve the result later.

For method signatures, options, and callbacks, see the [Web SDK reference](/external/reference).
